name: Iron

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: Oral iron salts used to replete iron stores. There is no regulated excretory route for iron, so supplementation without a demonstrated deficiency risks accumulation, particularly in undiagnosed haemochromatosis.

systems.note: Repletion of iron stores for erythropoiesis; the intended effect.
Iron accumulates hepatically and has no regulated excretory route.

monitors.why: The storage index and the value supplementation is titrated against.
Distinguishes repletion from iron overload, which ferritin alone does not.
The numerator of transferrin saturation; read with TIBC rather than alone.
The functional endpoint of iron repletion.
Iron accumulates hepatically with no excretory route.
